_about: The mood vocabulary for track tags, confirmed by CJ on 2026-09-14. The model may only choose from these sixteen; an off-list tag rejects the album's reply for that run. The glosses steer the model and never reach the app.

moods.gloss: awe, discovery, a vista opening up
looking back with warmth, a memory of home
gentle and intimate, a quiet closeness
big, forceful, a wall of sound
suspense, dread, something about to happen
love, longing, a swell of feeling
